access_notes: Free tier available from transcriptapi.com; API key on signup; YouTube's own API also has captions endpoint
api_capabilities: Video transcript retrieval, subtitle extraction, timestamp data
mcp_notes: No official MCP server; community YouTube transcript tools exist

name: Grain
what_it_does: AI meeting recorder that captures highlights, generates clips, and syncs notes to CRM
access_notes: Free plan available; API access via account settings; limited API surface
api_capabilities: Meeting recordings, highlights, clips, CRM sync, transcripts
